strengths.evidence: Marathon finished Sep 2026; 50-60 km weeks in Aug/Sep; VO2max 54

limiters.evidence: Last 3 wks only 12-16 km/wk; LT pace 5:18/km is slower than sub-3:30 MP (4:58)

constraints: 5 runs/wk from wk 4: Tue quality, Wed easy, Thu MP or progression (alternating), Fri easy + strides, Sun long

Gym from wk 5: Mon upper pull + core, Tue legs after the quality run (the only lower-body session; no barbell squats or deadlifts until after the race: split squats/step-ups, single-leg RDL, heavy calf raises, Nordics/hamstring curls, RPE 7), Wed bench/push, Fri optional light single-leg work, Sat shoulders + arms. Legs drop to 2 light sets in wk 8, 9 and 11; none in race week
Gym limits: 4 sessions a week, 60 min max each; Saturday 45 min upper body, done by early afternoon; no gym on a morning with HRV under 60 or resting HR 7+ above normal
Long runs capped at 28 km / about 3 hours: 8-week average was 25 km/wk, and every long run so far was run 7-16 bpm over the cap
Plan only changes on red flags: HRV <60 two mornings running, RHR 7+ above baseline, pain, illness
Illness 14-16 Nov (fever): wk 3 long run missed, wk 4 rest + easy return

Trip 27 Dec - 3 Jan: key sessions only, no gym (Tue intervals, Thu MP, Sun 3 Jan 24k w/ 10k MP). Long runs: 24k (6 Dec), 28k w/ 4k MP (13 Dec), 32k w/ 10k MP (20 Dec), 24k (Sat 26 Dec), 24k w/ 10k MP (3 Jan)
Gurgaon heat/pollution: HR caps over pace
COROS LTHR 166 is stale (held 175 on 10 Nov). 24 Nov 30-min test (moved from 17 Nov, illness) sets real LTHR + LT pace; easy runs then pace band + HR ceiling
Non-negotiable: easy = easy, no unplanned runs, no skipped key sessions, run your session not your partner's, gels on every long run 18k+, pain = stop

pace.easy: interim: HR ≤150, never faster than 6:40/km; reset by 24 Nov test (pace band + HR cap 88% new LTHR)

workouts.humanReadable: 16 km total. First 9 km easy (HR 140-150 bpm, cap 150. Pace 6:45-7:15/km, NEVER faster than 6:45 even if HR is low. Heat makes you slower than 7:15 at 150 = fine, HR wins) → 5 km @ MP 5:18-5:26/km (by pace) → 2 km easy

weeks.focus: Race week. No heavy lower-body lifting

workouts.name: No run — strength
workouts.description: Upper body only, light. No deadlift.

workouts.name: MP sharpener 3x1.6k
workouts.description: Key quality session. Full 2 km warm-up + 2 km cool-down easy. Run the written pace. If you physically cannot hold it, stop the hard part and jog home easy; never grind reps at 175 bpm.
workouts.humanReadable:
2 km easy WU
3x1.6 km @ MP 5:18-5:26/km, 2 min jog between
2 km easy CD
Gym: no lower-body lifting this week.

workouts.name: Easy 5k
workouts.description: Aerobic volume. Conversational.
workouts.humanReadable:
5 km easy. HR 140-150 bpm, cap 150. Pace 6:45-7:15/km, NEVER faster than 6:45 even if HR is low. Heat makes you slower than 7:15 at 150 = fine, HR wins
Gym: upper body light, or skip.

workouts.name: Easy 4k + strides
workouts.description: Aerobic volume. Conversational.

Then 6x20s strides (fast, relaxed, ~4:30/km) w/ 40s walk

workouts.name: No run — strength
workouts.description: Rest. No leg day. Carb loading starts (8-10 g per kg).

workouts.name: No run — strength
workouts.description: Rest or 15 min shakeout. Carb load, bib pickup, kit laid out, sleep early.

workouts.name: TATA MUMBAI MARATHON
workouts.description: Race day.
workouts.humanReadable: Goal 3:45 (5:20/km). Km 0-5: 5:25-5:28. Km 5-30: 5:18-5:22, HR 158 or below. Km 30+: hold or push if HR allows. Gel every 30 min.

run.targetPace: 5:18-5:22/km (goal 3:45); 5:13/km only if the 24 Nov test gives LT pace ≤5:05/km and the MP blocks on 20 Dec feel controlled (3:40)
run.notes: Km 0-5 at 5:25-5:28 (crowded, dark, humid). Don't chase pace on Bandra-Worli Sea Link incline — hold effort. Bank nothing. Expect late-race rise toward Peddar Road / Marine Drive and rising heat after ~7 am: if temp >24°C / very humid, add 5-10 s/km and race HR, not pace. Halfway target ~1:53.

nutrition.preRace: Wake 3:00-3:15. 2.5-3 h before: 100-150 g carbs low-fibre (white bread/jam/banana/rice) + 500 ml fluid w/ electrolytes. Gel 15 min pre-start.

products: Gel every 30 min (same brand as long runs)

nutrition.notes: Rehearse exact fuel on wk 7, 8, 9 long runs. Carb load Fri-Sat (8-10 g/kg/day). Nothing new on race day.

taper.notes: Wk 11 ~-30%, wk 12 ~-55% excl race. Keep MP touches. One light leg session wk 11 (Tue), none wk 12.
